entities.label: JUDGE

sentences.text:
Ravi Malimath, Chief Justice passed the following:
 ORDER
This petition is said to have been filed seeking to espouse the public interest.
The sum and substance of the plea of the petitioners is that the training being accorded for Food Inspector is being done for incompetent persons.
An interim order was granted to the effect that the respondents-State be directed to appoint only persons eligible under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and the Rules thereunder.
Learned Deputy Advocate General submits that all persons being appointed are those that are eligible under the said Act and the Rules.

In view of the submission made and interim order being continued and complied with by the State,
no further orders are called for in this petition.
The petition is disposed off accordingly.

(RAVI MALIMATH) (PURUSHAINDRA KUMAR KAUR  CHIEF JUSTICE JUDGE  S/
